title: LSP: reuse with composition
purpose: Compare inappropriate Queue-as-List contract with composition and interface-based backing list.
alt: List 계약을 충족하지 못하는 Queue 상속과 List 객체·인터페이스를 합성하는 재사용 방식 비교
requiredChecks: Three designs shown: Queue extends List; Queue contains List; Queue contains List interface implemented by MyList.
List operations insert/delete/find; Queue operations insert/delete/isEmpty.
Bad inheritance is explicitly conditional on Queue not honoring the full List contract in this example.
Composition arrows mean has-a/delegates, not inheritance; MyList implements List interface.
